articles.title: A Mysterious Space Signal That Still Has Scientists Scratching Their Heads
articles.summary: In 1977, a telescope picked up a strange radio burst from space that lasted 72 seconds. No one has ever heard it again. Could it have been aliens?

articles.title: NASA Wants Your Big Idea for Living on the Moon!
articles.summary: NASA is asking college students to dream up cool ways to live and work on the Moon. The best teams can win $7,500 and a trip to Florida to share their ideas.

articles.title: Why Do Ants and Bees Live in Big Family Groups? A 60-Year-Old Idea Might Be Wrong
articles.summary: Scientists used to think ants, bees, and wasps lived in huge colonies because of a special way they inherit genes. But a new study of nearly 69,000 species says that's not the whole story.
